analyzed_vuln.description: In the array append path of ZEND_ASSIGN_DIM_SPEC_VAR_UNUSED_OP_DATA_VAR_HANDLER, the handler dereferences `value` (via `ZVAL_DEREF`) and may then destroy the original op_data zval (`zval_ptr_dtor_nogc(free_op_data)`) when `value != free_op_data`. If `value` points into the same reference container that gets released, `value` becomes dangling, but the code still uses it for `ZVAL_COPY(EX_VAR(opline->result.var), value)` when RETURN_VALUE_USED is true. This creates a heap-use-after-free in the same handler (free at ~27527, UAF read at ~27548).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires the ASSIGN_DIM VAR/UNUSED/OP_DATA_VAR opcode variant with array append (`$arr[] = ...`) where op_data is a VAR that is a reference-like value such that `_get_zval_ptr_var` + `ZVAL_DEREF` yields a `value` alias not equal to `free_op_data`, then `zval_ptr_dtor_nogc(free_op_data)` frees the referenced container before the return-value copy executes. The PoC drives this through crafted PHP bytecode/script under php-fuzz-execute so RETURN_VALUE_USED is set and the stale `value` pointer is copied, causing ASan UAF.
